opportunities.title: Research Awards (Research and Travel Grants)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards not made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. Retrospective applications not considered. Welcomes early career researchers.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants of £500 to £5,000 to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, across archaeology, art history, architectural and buildings history, material culture, and the history of collecting. Includes named awards (Hugh Phillips, Margaret and Tom Jones, Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales, Open Research) with a 15 January deadline. Named sub-awards include Marion Wilson Awards, Joan Pye Awards, and Hugh Chapman Memorial Awards.

opportunities.title: Named Research Awards (Beatrice de Cardi, Janet Arnold, Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler, William Lambarde)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards not made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. Retrospective applications not considered. Two references required for Margaret and Tom Jones Memorial and Beatrice De Cardi awards.
opportunities.summary: Named research and travel awards within the Research and Travel Grants programme, including Beatrice de Cardi, Janet Arnold, Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler travel awards, and William Lambarde travel awards, with a 7 April annual deadline. The Wheeler and Lambarde awards are travel awards for research travel.

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required for Morris applications. Supporting documents such as photographs, architect/conservation reports or budgets must be uploaded.
opportunities.summary: Grants for the conservation of church interiors/furnishings and related church conservation projects, with two application rounds each year on 31 March and 31 August.

opportunities.title: Linda Parry Textile Conservation and Research Grants

deadlines.raw: Follows William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants deadlines (31 March and 31 August)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required. Applications submitted via the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants form.
opportunities.summary: Grants for textile conservation and research. Applications are made through the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants application form, following the same deadlines.
